以下是當開啟選單時，想顯示道具\\n上方的恢復道具欄位。: This is reserved for the recovery item slot\nshown at the top of the menu.
讓使用者從死亡中復活。（恢復一半的 HP。）: Revives the user from death. (Restores half of their HP.)
治療使用者除了死亡以外的異常狀態。: Cures all abnormal states except death.
恢復一半的 HP 和 MP 。: Restores half of HP and MP.
一段時間內，減半敵人的遭遇機率。: Halves the enemy encounter rate for a period of time.
一段時間內增加戰鬥後的道具與金錢獲得率。: Increases item and gold drop rates after battles for a period of time.
使用後會消失的卷軸，會立刻返回普通城鎮: A scroll that disappears after use and immediately returns you to a normal town.
假如卡死、破圖、或是攝影機有問題\\n打開選單使用「卡點恢復」回到安全區: If you get stuck, encounter broken graphics, or have camera issues,\nopen the menu and use "Stuck Recovery" to return to a safe area.
裝滿油的罐子，點火後丟出去可造成火焰傷害\\n有機會引燃敵人: A jar filled with oil. Ignite and throw it to deal Fire damage.\nMay ignite the enemy.
裝滿雷電粉末的罐子，丟出去可造成雷電傷害\\n有機會麻痺敵人: A jar filled with lightning powder. Throw it to deal Thunder damage.\nMay paralyze the enemy.
裝滿霜寒粉末的罐子，丟出去可造成冰屬傷害\\n有機會造成凍傷效果: A jar filled with frost powder. Throw it to deal Ice damage.\nMay inflict Freeze.
一個可以打開任務面板的工具\\n取代傳統文書作業，委託人再也不用排隊等候: A tool that opens the Quest Board.\nReplaces traditional paperwork, so clients no longer have to wait in line.
假如忘記要做什麼，可按下「N」開啟「任務筆記本」\\n會給你現在要做什麼的提示或: If you forget what you are supposed to do, press "N" to open the "Quest Notebook".\nIt provides hints about what to do next or displays quest descriptions.
假如你嫌走路麻煩，可按下「T」使用「傳送石」\\n可以立刻前往紀錄過的地點: If you find walking troublesome, press "T" to use the "Teleport Stone".\nIt allows you to instantly travel to recorded locations.
跟債務水晶相似魔力波長的水晶碎片\\n相傳說帶有水晶的人會遭到詛咒並且強化魔物: A crystal fragment with a magical wavelength similar to the Debt Crystal.\nLegend says that those who carry the crystal will be cursed and strengthen monsters.
初始之地的戰鬥證明: Proof of battle in the Starting Area.
中級試煉的戰鬥證明: Proof of battle in the Intermediate Trial.
高級試煉的戰鬥證明: Proof of battle in the Advanced Trial.
頂級試煉的戰鬥證明: Proof of battle in the Expert Trial.
皇家試煉的戰鬥證明: Proof of battle in the Royal Trial.
道具店老闆在尋找的草藥\\n也是讓藥水變貴的元凶: The herb the item shop owner is looking for.\nIt is also the culprit behind the rising price of potions.
一種特殊的黏著劑，常被用來作為家具修繕\\n然而有個天才打算用在武器製作上: A special adhesive commonly used for repairing furniture.\nHowever, some genius plans to use it for weapon crafting.
受魔力影響的植物製成的纖維\\n有阻隔寒氣的效果，常用來做成冬衣: Fibers made from plants affected by magic.\nThey can block the cold and are commonly used to make winter clothing.
被凍結的稀有藥草，閃閃發光喔: A frozen rare herb. It sparkles!
被結晶包覆的吊墜，看起來是某人的重要物品: A pendant covered in crystal. It looks like an important item belonging to someone.
